definitions.gloss: to take a shortcut; to cut through
definitions.explanation: To go by a shorter route than the usual one to save time or distance.

definitions.gloss: to take the easy way; to cut corners
definitions.explanation: To try to achieve something by an easier but possibly less thorough method.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧{近道|ちかみち}する。
examples.english: To take a shortcut through the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{近道|ちかみち}しよう。
examples.english: We don't have time, so let's take a shortcut.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裏道|うらみち}→裏道：19428_uramichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{近道|ちかみち}したら、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I took a shortcut using the back streets and arrived earlier than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There are no shortcuts to learning.

examples.japanese: {近道|ちかみち}しよう⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I tried to take a shortcut and failed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地道|じみち}→地道：15599_jimichi⟧な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the shortcut to success is steady effort.

notes:
⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧ (shortcut) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The noun ⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧ can stand alone (meaning a shorter path), and when combined with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, it becomes a verb meaning to take that shorter path.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧ — go via a shortcut
- ⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — there are no shortcuts
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧ — shortcut to success
- ⟦{近道|ちかみち}→近道：03118_chikamichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ — show someone a shortcut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{道|みち}→抜け道：08370_nukemichi⟧ — back road; loophole — a hidden or lesser-known route; also means a way around rules
- ⟦{回|まわ}り{道|みち}→回り道：15766_mawarimichi⟧ — detour; roundabout way — the opposite: a longer route
